skills.description: Fetch and retrieve full-text or abstracts of open-access articles from PubMed Central by journal, year, or PMCID using NCBI's public APIs without an API key.
skills.description_zh: 通过NCBI公共API，无需API密钥，即可按期刊、年份或PMCID获取PubMed Central开放获取文章的全文或摘要。
skills.name: PMC Harvest
